components.name: YuE2-3B + YuE2-Vae (+ Vae-legacy)
components.notes: ~71 s per 3.6-min song on RTX 4090 (VENDOR). Accepts user ABC score; cot='melody' recommended for covers. Archive the GitHub MODEL_LICENSE commit as the rights record. User-ABC contract (GAP-02): strict two-voice dialect, no tuplets or pickups, one integer tempo, lyrics bound only by section tags, ~6 min maximum, zh/en only. README and MODEL_LICENSE name different licensing contacts; issue #219 unanswered.
components.output_terms: Individuals acting in an individual capacity may publish, sell, license and monetize outputs, no royalties; companies need a commercial license for weight use; no commercial redistribution of weights
components.role: Quality and score/melody-conditioned lane on a CUDA worker
components.verdict_condition: Conditional on Q1 (a BF16 NVIDIA worker or approved rental passes smoke) and Q3 (individual operator). Not usable for LLC work, including Sabbath Echo.
